module: Flowgraph node "Monologue" (category once_f_duration, duration): displays a series of messages one after another with ui_message. Inputs: "category" (flowgraph), "icon" (error), then for each message i: "message_i" (any) and "duration_i" (5 s). The duration output goes to 'finished' at the end of the sum of the durations.
notes: Uses dtSim (simulation time), so the progression stops when paused.
The message_i/duration_i pins are removed according to lnk.sourcePin (instead of targetPin), so the links are not removed properly.
If a duration_i is nil, the sum causes an error.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets index, time and current message.

updatePins.desc: Adjusts the number of pin pairs.

work.desc: Advances the simulation time and displays each message in turn; finishes after the last duration.
